encounter: E0199 TRAINER_JANI (AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F, Feather Badge, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: The Abandoned Ship is reached by Surf on Route 108 after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: New Mauville entrance via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Haunter plus Linking Cord (30), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20), Sneasel (14), Thwackey line (36), Togepi Route 102 plus Shiny Stone (24). All precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: The hidden trick here is Costar: Simple Bibarel's Swords Dance is a four-stage boost, and a Flamigo entering on the support slot's switch copies the whole thing for free - so a Bibarel that sets up and then dies hands Jani a fresh +4 attacker. Two ways to stop it, and I am bringing both. Gengar's Taunt blanks Swords Dance at the source, and it also blanks Clefairy's entire kit, which is four status moves and nothing else. Failing that, kill Bibarel during the setup rather than after: Magnezone's Electric is 2x on Bibarel and Flamigo and 4x on Pelipper, Rillaboom's Grass is 2x on Bibarel and Pelipper, and Weavile's Knock Off removes Clefairy's Eviolite. Clefairy's Friend Guard means everything I aim at its partner is reduced while it lives, so Clefairy is the first target even though it is the highest-level member - and Gengar's Sludge Bomb is 2x into it. The one thing to respect is Flamigo's Wide Guard, which turns off spread damage for a turn.
